_comment: Copy this file to ticket-master.config.json and fill in your own values.
_comment_placeholders: Optional: if this config lives in a folder synced across several machines (e.g. a cloud-synced parent directory), 'tickets_dir' and any project_roots[].path may use the placeholders <HOME> (current user's home directory) and <USER> (OS user name) instead of a literal, host-specific path -- same convention as config/ticket-writer.config.example.json. The agent following the TICKET-MASTER prompt resolves these to the current host's actual values before any file access; a literal path is still fine for a single-machine setup.
_comment_tickets_dir: Every writer in the package resolves this path in one order: --tickets-dir, then the TICKET_MASTER_TICKETS_DIR environment variable, then THIS entry (lib/config_paths.py resolve_tickets_dir). Setting it here alone is enough. Prefer it over the variable: a process started before the variable was set never inherits it, which is how T-20260913-156957497 produced a bare TypeError although the path was configured. Use an intentional live queue, never the repository's ./tickets fixture. Create the queue root once with: python bin/ticket_master.py --init-queue <this path>. That command is the only way the .ticket-master-queue marker comes into being -- never write the marker by hand (a hand-made marker once turned a fixture folder into a second live queue). Queues that already carry a v1 marker, or a contract-bearing README.md plus _templates/TICKET.txt, are still accepted. Folders inside a module or mirror tree are refused even with a marker.
_comment_systems_registry: Routing schema v2 (transfer/fork/target tickets) needs a system-registry snapshot. DERIVE it, never write it by hand -- a hand-written one fakes the evidence the routing contract asks for: python lib/systems_registry.py --systems-dir <your inventory seeds> --out <this path>. ticket_writer.py resolves the path in this order: --systems-registry, then the TICKET_MASTER_SYSTEMS_REGISTRY environment variable, then THIS entry. Setting it here alone is enough -- you no longer have to keep a second copy in the environment. That double bookkeeping was the actual defect (T-20260913-734536498): the variable was set at user level, but a process started earlier had not inherited it, and every transfer ticket failed although the path was configured. Rebuild the snapshot whenever the set of machines changes -- a stale one silently routes to a host that no longer exists.
_comment_prompts_dir: Repository-local directory containing TICKET-MASTER.<lang>.md. All three starters resolve this field through bin/ticket_master.py; paths escaping the repository root are rejected.
_comment_language: Prompt language. Override at runtime with TM_LANG; invalid or missing language files fall back to 'en' with a warning.
_comment_bach_lease: OPTIONAL and OFF by default (server mode when enabled=true): couple claims to a task lease on a central task DB so the lease is the canonical claim and the filename suffix T-....<HOST>.txt is only a display. With enabled=true, ticket_mover --claim-current-host takes the lease BEFORE the rename (409 foreign holder = always refused, holder named; unreachable lead or missing token = refused unless fail_open=true), moves into SOLVED/BLOCKED/WAITING/USER/ACTIONABLE or --release-session release it (done/blocked/return), --backfill-leases --host <HOST> acquires leases for own claims without a valid lease or marked pending_lease, and --renew-leases cleans stale cache entries, renews held leases and runs backfill at the end. lead_url, keyring_service and keyring_entries are YOUR values (keep them in your local, git-ignored config); the token is read from token_env or, if the optional 'keyring' package is installed, from keyring_service/keyring_entries ({host} is replaced by the host name). state_file caches lease capabilities (and pending_lease fallback markers) and must NOT be inside a OneDrive tree. See lib/bach_lease.py.

bach_lease._comment_fail_open: Keep false (fail-closed) for public installs. When true, an unreachable lead or missing token falls back to file mode: ticket_mover writes a visible VERLAUF fallback note ('Claim ohne Lease (Fallback Dateibetrieb): ...') into the ticket and records pending_lease in state_file so --backfill-leases (or --renew-leases) acquires the lease later. A 409 conflict (foreign holder) never falls open.

project_roots._comment: Add your own project directories here.
project_roots.name: my-software

claude._comment: Anthropic Claude CLI (https://github.com/anthropic-ai/claude-code). Set TM_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=1 to pass --dangerously-skip-permissions.

codex._comment: OpenAI Codex CLI (https://github.com/openai/codex). Adjust command path as needed.

agy._comment: Gemini CLI or compatible wrapper. Adjust command path as needed.

kimi._comment: Kimi Code CLI. The bootstrap text is appended as the final argument, so the command must end in the headless flag. Note that -p cannot be combined with --yolo/--auto. Adjust the command path as needed; on some hosts the binary is kimi-code rather than kimi.

_comment_session_profile_path: Optional private per-OS-user JSON profile (schema ticket-master.session-profile.v1). Default: <HOME>/.config/ticket-master/session-profile.json; TM_SESSION_PROFILE overrides. Never commit personal preferences, decision IDs or log paths here. lib/session_boot.py --report displays the effective settings at role boot.
_comment_agent_launcher: Optional inner companion SDK only: set agent_launcher_work_root to an existing private directory. A null registry_dir uses the AgentLauncher user default. No runtime starts while the personal profile is pending; role, provider and model resolve through installed TASKPLAN configuration. No public default model or private admission is stored here.

execution_binding._comment: Schema-v2 execution bindings store an absolute UTC expiry in each ticket. 'never' is allowed only as an explicit ticket override; expiry never completes a ticket or changes its target snapshot.

advisor._comment: Optional: advisor model for high-stakes tickets (score >= 35). Not programmatically configurable in all harnesses — may require manual activation.

score_thresholds._comment: FALLBACK ONLY (Phase 3, T-20260704-02): used when 'router_command' below is unset or unreachable. Map score ranges to provider tiers. Adjust to match your available models.

_comment_router_command: Phase 3 (T-20260704-02): optional external multi-model/task router (CLI or script). If set, the prompt consults it FIRST for tier/model recommendation; 'score_thresholds' above only applies as a fallback when this is null or the router is unreachable.
_comment_task_db_command: Phase 3 (T-20260704-02): optional 'later' sink for tickets whose urgency (see config/urgency.json) is 'woche' or 'backlog' -- a background task-tracking CLI/API entry point. If null, such tickets fall back to DECISION LADDER item 1 (the project's own task management).

logging._comment: Deprecated: intake_log (shared file) removed in 1.5.0 - audit trail lives per ticket (STATUS/LOG/SOLUTION fields).

auditor_bridge._comment: T-20260830-948243522: bridge to the sibling system-auditor module (lib/auditor_bridge.py). Only relevant if system-auditor is installed -- see prompts/TICKET-MASTER.<lang>.md step (c6). 'enabled' defaults to false so a session start never fires an unattended multi-agent audit run; 'min_interval' is informational cadence documentation only and is NOT consulted by decide() -- system-auditor's own time-grid/period already governs due-ness (asked via due_check()), so a second cadence store here would be exactly the parallel standard this ticket's investigation forbids.
auditor_bridge._comment_location_base: Optional base for resolving local relative location= paths in dated readback receipts. Null uses the invoking process's working directory. Foreign-host locations, foreign absolute path syntax, network paths and placeholders such as <OneDrive> remain unresolved and are only syntax-checked.

_comment_reports_dir: Optional override for auditor_bridge's due_check(). Left null, lib/auditor_bridge.py resolves it from the installed system_auditor package's own resolved config (reports_dir, <HOME> already expanded) -- never guessed independently.
_comment_findings_dir: Optional override for --findings-to-tickets. Left null, resolved the same way as reports_dir above (system_auditor.config.load().findings_dir).
_comment_sparmodus_paths: Optional overrides for auditor_bridge.spar_gate(). Left null, defaults to the Claude Code hook state files under ~/.claude/state/ and ~/.claude/hooks/token_budget_config.json (see ~/CLAUDE.md 'sparmodus'/'notaus').

agenda_bridge._comment: T-20261127-937209759: optional bridge to the shared 'agenda-setting' skill (lib/planning_bridges.py). Defaults to enabled=false for public installs. When enabled, reads canonical agent-agenda.v1 state (profile_path -> AGENT_AGENDA_PROFILE -> ~/.config/agent-agenda/profile.json -> state_root/agenda.json) without creating a second agenda store; disabled or expired agendas never weight tickets.

calendar_bridge._comment: T-20261127-937209759 / T-20261127-860979068: optional bridge to the local 'kalender' skill SQLite store (v0.1 events or v0.2 multi-calendar silos) and/or Ocean calendar SQLite table (assistant_calendar). Defaults to enabled=false and dry-run planning; --plan-calendar --apply writes idempotently into ticket_calendar_id (default 'tickets' on v0.2 stores, optionally mirroring into 'user' when mirror_to_user=true) and never mutates existing v0.1 schemas.
